name: Rice bowl
intro: October's rice bowl is built from a tray of roasted sweet potato and the last charred poblanos. Something sharp goes on top.
keep: Ground beef or turkey, or leftover braised chicken

variations.ingredients: Ground beef + poblano + sweet potato + pomegranate
variations.context: The one you'll make most. Sweet, smoke, something sharp.

finish: Something sharp, last, every time — pomegranate, lime, or lemon. October food is heavier than September's, and the squeeze matters more, not less.
